xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3950: Transcripts must stay discoverable: keep agent state at close-out, drop session.id, issue panel uses the agent transcript route — round-6 fix pass on feature/pan-3950 (PR #3951)

plan.title: Transcripts must stay discoverable: keep agent state at close-out, drop session.id, issue panel uses the agent transcript route
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5

narratives.Problem: PR #3951 on feature/pan-3950 implements W1–W5 of the PRD (close-out keeps agent state, session.id deleted, issue panel uses the agent transcript route, retention sweeps all agent dirs, docs). Round-5 adversarial review returned DO NOT MERGE with five blockers: (1) a transcript watch root whose fs.watch attachment fails is never retried because the root signature is recorded before watch() and errors are swallowed; (2) markAgentRunning swallows every session-reset unlink error, so a launch can report success while transcript candidates stay blocked; (3) the transcript adapters (summary forks/handoffs) still scan Pi/ACP/Kimi paths themselves, non-recursively, so a nested Pi transcript readable by live APIs fails the summary-fork lookup with HTTP 400; (4) the equal-mtime Pi tie-break test cannot fail (walk order already equals path order under a stable sort) — the review's doubled-path claim itself is wrong; (5) the branch is net +49 production lines against origin/main, violating AC-6/NFR-1. CI was fully green on the same code, so these are design and test-strength gaps.
narratives.Proposal: Fix pass on the existing branch, no recut. w6: per-root watcher map in ws-rpc.ts that attaches only missing roots, sets rerun only when something new attached, and retries a failed root on the next event from a surviving watcher (no timers). w7: clearSessionResetMarker rethrows non-ENOENT and runs before markAgentRunning mutates status; dead isAgentSessionReset/readSessionIdHistorySync deleted; unterminated-final-record reset test added. w8: pi/acp/kimi adapters delegate resolveSessionFile to the central resolver helpers, deleting both *FromTmux scanners — the largest deletion lever. w9: rewrite the Pi tie-break test so walk order ≠ path order; pi.ts untouched. w10: two doc bullets in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and a '## Review round 5' table on PR #3951. w11: measure AC-11 and draw from the PRD D-7 fallback deletion list until production lines are net negative.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not recut the branch from main or reimplement W1–W5; every item is a commit on feature/pan-3950 at e42bb79eb39 or later.
- Do not remove the session-reset marker or derive reset-in-effect from sessions.json alone (changes resume semantics for ACP/OhMyPi whose ids are observed post-launch; PRD D-3).
- Do not edit src/lib/runtimes/pi.ts (PRD D-6); the resolver is correct, the test was weak.
- Do not add any setTimeout/setInterval/polling to transcript discovery; a total watch-attachment failure leaves the stream in 'discovering' until the client re-subscribes (PRD D-2).
- Do not add a second transcript resolver or any harness path scan outside src/lib/runtimes/* and src/lib/agents/transcript-resolver.ts.
- Do not touch the *Promise + Effect-wrapper pairs in src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts (PAN-3958).
- Do not invent deletions beyond the PRD D-7 fallback list to reach net-negative; stop and report instead.
- Do not delete or truncate anything under ~/.claude/projects.
- Do not merge PR #3951; do not run the full vitest suite locally (CI does).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the session-reset marker and make its removal fail loudly (non-ENOENT rethrow) instead of deleting the marker in favour of a sessions.json-derived rule.
autoDecisions.rationale: The marker also blocks resolveLatestSessionIdSync from resuming acp-session-id / OhMyPi freshest-JSONL sessions after a reset; those ids are observed after launch, so a last-record-is-reset rule would leave those harnesses blocked until an entry is appended. Changing that is a separate design decision the operator did not ask for in this pass.

autoDecisions.summary: Watcher retry is per-root bookkeeping with rerun only on a new attachment; the all-fail case stays in 'discovering' with one console.warn and no timer.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's constraint is event-driven discovery only. Any mismatch-triggered rerun would busy-loop on a permanently failing root; a timer fallback would be polling.

autoDecisions.summary: Blocker 4 is resolved by strengthening the test, not by changing findPiTranscriptPath.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified: the test passes agentsDir (the agents root) as agentsDirOverride and the file passes 43/43; the review's doubled-path claim is wrong. The genuine gap is that a stable name-sorted walk makes tied files come out in path order without the tie-break, so the fixture must place the lexically-later file where it is walked first.

autoDecisions.summary: Net-negative production lines is a dedicated final item with an enumerated fallback deletion list (PRD D-7) rather than a global 'delete until negative' instruction.
autoDecisions.rationale: The projected net after w6–w9 is about +4, so an explicit, bounded fallback list keeps the work agent from inventing risky deletions in hardened code (state-dir-removal.ts, retention).

autoDecisions.summary: Docs surface for the fix pass is docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md plus the PR #3951 round-5 table and the transcript-adapter module header.
autoDecisions.rationale: The user-visible behaviour W1–W5 documented earlier is unchanged; what changed is the single-resolver guarantee and the watch-retry semantics, both of which the architecture doc's transcript section describes.
